event.message: Launching a fresh browser: 1280×800, no cookies, not signed in.
Opened the product page. A modal appeared 1.2 s after load, without any action from me.
Reading the modal. Its only exit is a link: "No thanks, I prefer paying full price".

finding.title: Decline link shames the shopper
finding.explanation: A first-order offer opened 1.2 s after the page loaded, without any action from the shopper. Its only exit is a link that frames saying no as a foolish choice, rather than a neutral "No thanks".

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

evidence.elementText: No thanks, I prefer paying full price
observations: Modal appeared unprompted, 1.2 s after load
Decline wording: "No thanks, I prefer paying full price"
No close (×) button: the shaming link is the only way out

finding.remediation: Use neutral decline wording such as “No thanks”, and give the popup a visible close button.

event.message: Dismissed the modal. Staying on the page for 8 s, like a shopper reading the details.
Urgency signals: a countdown at 09:51, "Hurry, only 2 left in stock!" and a sales-volume claim. One look can't tell real from fake, so I've asked Navigator for a second look.
Pulling 13 weeks of price history for SonicBuds Pro ANC Wireless Earbuds…
Sold at ₹1,499–₹1,599 all quarter. MRP changed ₹1,999 → ₹3,999 7 days ago.

finding.title: 62% discount is calculated off an MRP raised 7 days ago
finding.explanation: The page advertises ₹1,499 as 62% off an MRP of ₹3,999. Over the last 13 weeks the product sold at ₹1,499–₹1,599 against an MRP of ₹1,999. The MRP was raised to ₹3,999 7 days ago and the product has never sold at that price. Against the genuine reference price, the discount is 25%.

rule.clause: Sec. 2(28) misleading advertisement; Sec. 2(47) unfair trade practice

evidence.elementText: Festive Sale price ₹1,499 MRP ₹3,999 62% off Inclusive of all taxes
observations: Advertised: ₹1,499, MRP ₹3,999 (62% off)
Last 13 weeks: sold at ₹1,499–₹1,599, never at ₹3,999
MRP changed ₹1,999 → ₹3,999, 7 days ago
Discount against the prior MRP: 25%

finding.remediation: Compare against a price the product was genuinely sold at recently (for example the lowest price of the last 30 days), not an inflated MRP.

event.message: Reloading the page for a second look.
Timer went from 09:51 to 09:59 after the reload: the deadline moved later.

finding.title: Countdown timer restarts on every page load
finding.explanation: The "Deal ends in" countdown read 09:51 after 8 s on the page. Straight after a reload it read 09:59. A real deadline cannot move later, so this timer is restarting per visit and the urgency it creates is false.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

frames.caption: First look, after 8 s on the page

observations: Before reload: 09:51
After reload: 09:59
The deadline moved later, which a real end time cannot do

finding.remediation: Show a real end time that does not move, or remove the countdown. Show stock levels only when they come from live inventory.

event.message: Stock badge is identical on every look and on every colour.

finding.title: "Only 2 left" never changes
finding.explanation: The scarcity badge shows the same count on first load, after a reload and after switching colour. Different colours normally carry separate stock, so an identical "2 left" everywhere is consistent with a hard-coded message rather than live inventory.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

observations: Read on 3 looks: "Hurry, only 2 left in stock!" every time
Looks taken: first load, after a reload, after a colour change
Same count for Midnight Black and Ocean Blue

finding.remediation: Show a real end time that does not move, or remove the countdown. Show stock levels only when they come from live inventory.

event.message: "120+ bought in the last 24 hours" has no source, and nothing on the page can confirm or refute it.
Confidence 0.58 is below the 0.75 threshold. Sending to human review instead of asserting it.

finding.title: "120+ bought in the last 24 hours" cannot be verified
finding.explanation: This sales-volume claim may well be true: the figure is plausible for a popular product and the agent has no access to order data. Rather than assert a violation, the adjudicator sent it to a reviewer who can check it against real orders.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

observations: Claim: "120+ bought in the last 24 hours"
No source, timestamp or link behind the figure
Adjudicator confidence 0.58, below the 0.75 threshold

finding.remediation: Show a real end time that does not move, or remove the countdown. Show stock levels only when they come from live inventory.

event.message: Choosing colour: Ocean Blue.
Price stays ₹1,499 on every colour, so there's no bait-and-switch between variants.
Added 1 × SonicBuds Pro (Ocean Blue) to the cart. Opening the cart.
Comparing the cart with what I actually added: expected 1 line, found 2.

finding.title: Protection plan added to the cart without consent
finding.explanation: The agent added exactly one item to the cart. The cart then held two lines: a ₹199 "1-Year Accidental Damage Protection" had been added automatically. The shopper never ticked, chose or was asked about it.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

evidence.elementText: 1-Year Accidental Damage Protection 12 months · Sold by BazaarNest Care ₹199 REMOVE
observations: Added by the agent: 1 line (SonicBuds Pro, Ocean Blue)
Found in cart: 2 lines
Extra line: 1-Year Accidental Damage Protection, ₹199
Cart total ₹1,698 instead of ₹1,499

finding.remediation: Never add items to the cart for the shopper. Offer add-ons as an unticked option with the price shown next to it.

event.message: Proceeding to checkout with the saved address.
Membership checkbox arrived ticked: ₹99/month, terms in 10 px grey.

finding.title: Paid membership ticked by default
finding.explanation: Checkout enrols the shopper in BazaarNest Plus at ₹99/month unless they spot and untick it. The recurring charge and the "cancelled via written request" exit are in 10 px grey fine print, so leaving is made deliberately hard.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

frames.caption: Membership section on arrival at checkout

evidence.elementText: Add BazaarNest Plus: free express delivery and early access to sales ₹99/month, billed from today. Auto-renews until cancelled via written request.
observations: Checkbox state on arrival: ticked
Recurring-charge terms: 10 px, light grey
Cancellation only "via written request", with no online exit
₹99 added to the order total

finding.remediation: Leave memberships unticked by default, show the recurring price in normal type, and allow one-click online cancellation.

event.message: Delivery step: a full-width ₹79 Express button against an 11 px grey link for free delivery.

finding.title: Paid upgrade is a giant button, free option a tiny grey link
finding.explanation: The delivery step makes the ₹79 Express upgrade the full-width primary action. The free standard option is an 11 px grey text link beneath it, styled to be missed. "Most customers choose Express" adds unverified social pressure.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

evidence.elementText: ⚡ Get it tomorrow with Express Most customers choose Express delivery UPGRADE TO EXPRESS · ₹79 continue with standard delivery
observations: Express: full-width, bold, saffron button
Standard (free): 11 px grey link, no button
Both lead to payment; only the paid one looks like a choice

finding.remediation: Give paid and free choices equal visual weight, for example two equally styled options.

event.message: Choosing free standard delivery via the small grey link, as a careful shopper would.
Reconciling prices: product ₹1,499 → cart ₹1,698 → checkout ₹1,797 → payment ₹1,894.

finding.title: ₹97 in fees appears only at the payment step
finding.explanation: The product page showed ₹1,499 "inclusive of all taxes" with free delivery. Platform fee (₹29), Handling fee (₹49), Convenience fee (₹19) were first shown on the payment step, after the shopper had invested in the journey. None was disclosed on the product, cart or checkout pages.

rule.source: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Dark Patterns, 2023

evidence.elementText: Festive Sale price ₹1,499 MRP ₹3,999 62% off Inclusive of all taxes
observations: Product page: ₹1,499
Cart: ₹1,698 · Checkout: ₹1,797 · Payment: ₹1,894
New at payment: platform fee ₹29, handling fee ₹49, convenience fee ₹19

finding.remediation: Include every unavoidable fee in the price shown on the product page, or show it clearly beside that price.
